Getting Started

What Is Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu? A Beginner's Guide for Hyannis Residents

October 21, 2026 · Cristyan BJJ Academy, Hyannis MA

Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ) is a grappling martial art built around one simple idea: technique and leverage can beat size and strength. Instead of striking, you learn to control an opponent on the ground, escape bad positions, and finish with joint locks or chokes, always with a training partner who taps when they have had enough.

Where BJJ comes from

BJJ grew out of judo and traditional jiu-jitsu brought to Brazil in the early 1900s. Brazilian families refined it with a heavy focus on ground fighting, and it later became the foundation of modern mixed martial arts.

What a typical class looks like

Most classes start with a warm-up, move into drilling a specific technique with a partner, and finish with positional sparring or live rolling. Beginners are never thrown into the deep end. You learn the basics, such as how to fall safely, hold guard, and escape mount, before anything else.

Why so many people on Cape Cod are trying it

From Hyannis and Barnstable to Yarmouth and Mashpee, people are looking for workouts that are more engaging than a treadmill. BJJ gives you a full-body workout, practical self-defense, and a community of training partners in one place.

How to start

You don't need to be in shape or have any experience. Wear comfortable athletic clothes, bring water, and show up curious. At Cristyan Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Academy on Iyannough Rd in Hyannis, our coaches walk every new student through the fundamentals step by step.

Train with us in Hyannis
